key_insights: AutoRound's adaptive quantization preserves nonlinear knowledge better than static GPTQ/AWQ — essential for reasoning models
Weight-only INT4/INT8 works for inference; activation-aware quantization needed for training loops
code_patterns:
# AutoRound Integration for AMD 780M
from auto_round import AutoRound
import torch

model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("model", torch_dtype=torch.float16)
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("model")

# Adaptive quantization - preserves reasoning
autoround = AutoRound(
    model, tokenizer,
    bits=4, group_size=128,
    dataset="c4",  # calibration data
    seqlen=2048
)
quantized_model = autoround.quantize()
quantized_model.save_pretrained("./model-autoround-4bit")
